levels.surface: عمرو بن عثمان بن سعيد بن كثير بن دينار
عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: «قال قال الزهري أخبرني عبيد الله» : Zuhri is the speaker and a link; Ubayd Allah is his source.
Marwan and Qabisa are in the story only (rule 5); the one who ends the chain is Fatima, whose account gives the Prophet's words. The divorcer and other persons described are not links.
